title: 壁面換気ルーバー
description: 7枚の傾斜羽根、水切り端部、奥行きのある枠とメッシュ防虫網を備えた金属製換気口。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A folded-metal wall outlet with seven sloping louvers, drip lips, deep frame and a fully modeled rear insect screen. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs. Repeated static parts are grouped into named assemblies; triangle-corner UVs and material records retained from original.

provenance.method: Original procedural geometry, followed by geometry-preserving static GLB assembly grouping
provenance.tool: Blender 4.5.14 LTS; Meshcopia city generator 1.0; grouping postprocessor with Python 3.12.14 and NumPy 2.3.5
provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.
provenance.alternateFormat: STL written by scripts/city/group_static_assemblies.py from exact grouped GLB triangle coordinates; meters, Y-up, no colors or UVs; no printability or manufacturing validation.
provenance.changes: Static repeated mesh parts grouped by original material within named major assemblies; no decimation, remeshing, UV change or material change. Candidate equivalence audited against frozen original GLB 49c551213a6c89938b4716a1ae6df221a5612aa7c9bbed162e542ea81745666f.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
